purpose: Prove bounded authentication readiness, bundled DSH fallback discovery and one normalized no-effect executor response without changing the current runtime owner.
architectureChange: separate installation, authentication and task-compatibility evidence for Claude Code, Codex and bundled DSH
discover DSH from the repository-locked runtime instead of requiring a global dsh executable
run one synthetic no-tool no-effect response through the shared normalized execution context
keep the compatibility runtime as the sole consumer, provider, scheduler and writer
allowedActions: execute only claude auth status --json and codex login status as fixed bounded authentication probes
read only repository package manifests and boolean presence of DSH inference configuration without reading or emitting secret values
use a temporary empty fixture workspace outside user workspaces
send one fixed public synthetic prompt to exactly one eligible executor with tools, workspace writes and continuation disabled
retain only executor id, protocol result code, bounded timing and content digest; discard raw response and process output
use no effect grants and no external write provider
commit and push the exact implementation after all gates pass
explicitExclusions: send user, business, customer, message, repository or internal data to any executor
invoke more than one executor or retry the synthetic action on another executor
enable tools, local file access, shell commands, browser, desktop, network tools or external writes inside the smoke action
install or upgrade a package, CLI, model or third-party project
start a cloud service, daemon, non-loopback listener or SSH connection
change DSH/Cordis or product runtime composition
activate the private Work Integration Pack
switch or duplicate a consumer, provider, scheduler or writer
migrate persistent data, delete a source or restart a service
validation: unit fixtures for command allowlist, output redaction, timeout, missing configuration and DSH package drift
real bounded authentication readback for installed Claude Code and Codex
real bundled DSH version and configuration-availability readback
one real synthetic no-effect response with no tools and no workspace data
assert one executor attempt, executorInvoked=true, effectsActive=0 and currentOwnerPreserved=true
private pack audit and root agent sync check

rollback.method: Terminate the one-shot child if still present, remove the temporary empty fixture workspace, then revert the single implementation commit.

sshTrackPrerequisites: verified SHA256 host-key fingerprint stored behind the local identity reference
least-privilege subsystem-only SSH identity and local credential reference
server-side quark-device-v1 subsystem implementation and synthetic test window
